researchTarget.question: Reconstruct the post-merger dilution and liquidity stack far enough to distinguish the pro-forma denominator from additional equity-plan, earnout and pre-funded-warrant overhang before any admission or opportunity assessment.

summary: Primary SEC evidence materially strengthens the dilution map but does not close the Chief directive. The 277,442,600 figure is explicitly a pro-forma weighted-average basic/diluted denominator, not a safe standalone current fully diluted share count. The same filing says its fully diluted ownership percentages exclude equity-incentive-plan reserves. A Sept. 4 S-8 separately registers 43,567,442 shares across rollover awards (9,936,483), the 2026 incentive plan (18,630,959) and ESPP (15,000,000). The merger also carries two conditional 10,000,000-share earnout tranches. Pre-merger S-4 fee tables contemplated up to 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants, while the closing pro-forma explains that beneficial-ownership caps can cause preferred/warrant holders to receive pre-funded warrants; the exact post-close pre-funded-warrant count still requires reconciliation. Liquidity evidence supports roughly $99.779m of pro-forma cash plus PIPE before restricted cash and before closing-cost adjustments, but this is not a normalized cash-runway calculation.

findings.finding: The Sept. 3 closing pro-forma reports 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average basic and diluted shares, composed of 17,645,106 historical Xtend weighted-average shares, 6,328,962 conversion adjustment, 196,725,338 preferred/warrant/SAFE conversion shares and 56,743,194 New PubCo shares for JFB security holders.

The filing states Xtend holders owned about 87.41% voting power and 79.61% economic interests on a fully diluted basis, explicitly excluding amounts reserved under the New PubCo equity incentive plan. Therefore 277,442,600 should not be treated as capturing all future plan dilution.

The Sept. 4 S-8 registers an aggregate 43,567,442 shares: 9,936,483 for rollover awards, 18,630,959 reserved under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan and 15,000,000 under the 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
The merger provides two conditional earnout tranches of 10,000,000 common shares each: one tied to at least $75m FY2026 revenue and one tied to at least $150m FY2027 revenue.

The July S-4/A fee table contemplated up to 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants. At closing, holders subject to the 4.99% beneficial-ownership cap could receive pre-funded warrants instead of common shares. This establishes a potentially material instrument class but does not establish the exact post-close outstanding quantity.

The pro-forma June 30 balance sheet shows $39.779m cash and cash equivalents plus a $60m PIPE adjustment, alongside $3.0m restricted cash and $0.680m restricted cash deposits. It also includes $15.520m accrued-liability adjustment for closing bonuses/transaction costs. These are useful liquidity anchors but are not a normalized runway.

For the six months ended June 30, 2026, historical Xtend shows $10.578m revenue, $0.916m gross profit, $26.036m operating loss and $19.364m net loss. The consolidated pro-forma operating loss is $34.465m for the six-month period. These figures warn against converting gross closing cash into a simplistic multi-year runway without separating JFB, transaction and nonrecurring effects.

inferences.inference: A mechanical maximum-overhang illustration that simply adds the 43,567,442 S-8 registered shares and 20,000,000 earnout shares to 277,442,600 would reach 341,010,042, about 22.9% above the pro-forma denominator. This is NOT a reconciled fully diluted count because rollover awards may already overlap the pro-forma treatment and pre-funded warrants/common substitutions must be reconciled rather than double-counted.

The Chief directive should remain open. The evidence is now sufficient to reject any use of 277,442,600 as an all-in fully diluted denominator, but not sufficient to state an exact current basic share count, exact pre-funded-warrant count or normalized runway.

contradictions: Company/press materials describe $60m received and other post-close reporting describes approximately $67.7m delivered at closing; the pro-forma balance sheet uses a $60m PIPE adjustment. These figures may describe different closing-cash definitions and must not be blended without the closing statement/8-K reconciliation.

The S-8 rollover-award registration is an overhang signal, but adding all 9,936,483 rollover shares to the 277,442,600 denominator may double-count awards already reflected in merger/pro-forma assumptions.
unknowns: Exact post-close common shares outstanding as of the latest authoritative filing.
Exact post-close pre-funded warrants outstanding after applying the 4.99% ownership cap and closing conversions.
How much of the 9,936,483 rollover-award S-8 pool is already embedded in the 277,442,600 pro-forma denominator.
Actual availability/issuance timing under the 18,630,959-share incentive reserve and 15,000,000-share ESPP reserve.
Whether either 10m-share earnout threshold is probable; no probability is assigned.
Normalized forward cash burn and runway after stripping transaction costs, JFB operations, working-capital movements and acquisition effects.
falsifiers: A post-close 8-K/10-Q or transfer-agent disclosure that provides a reconciled current common-share count plus pre-funded-warrant and assumed-award schedule supersedes the provisional denominator analysis.
Plan documents or award ledgers demonstrating that registered S-8 reserves are already fully included in the cited denominator would reduce the incremental-overhang interpretation.
Cash-flow evidence showing materially positive operating cash generation would falsify an inference of continuing financing dependence; no such conclusion is made here.
recommendedNextResearch: Locate the first post-close issuer filing or authoritative share-cap table stating exact common shares outstanding and exact pre-funded warrants outstanding.
Reconcile the 9,936,483 rollover awards against the merger denominator line-by-line to prevent double counting.
Build normalized runway from Xtend-only operating cash flow/working capital rather than pro-forma net loss; keep JFB and transaction costs separated.
